seo.body: The initial project consultation call is a focused conversation for founders, operators and teams deciding whether a custom website, portal, online store or internal web system is the right next move.

items.a: No. This call is a conversation to understand your project and recommend a next step. The technical audit is a separate, paid service: a review of an existing build that ends with written findings. If the call shows you need one, we say so.
items.q: Is this the same as a technical audit?

items.a: Bring the business goal, the current website or system if one exists, the main user journeys, and any deadlines or budget constraints. A rough brief is enough.
items.q: What should I prepare before the call?

items.a: Most consultation calls take around 30 minutes. Complex rebuilds or systems with integrations may need a follow-up architecture session before a final proposal.
items.q: How long does the call take?

items.a: We confirm the time by call or WhatsApp on the number you give. After the consultation call, we recommend one next step: a technical audit, a written proposal, a project estimate, or a decision not to build yet.

sections.body: The consultation call is a phone call on the number you give, at the time you pick. It is a working conversation about your project, not a sales pitch. Before the call, we confirm the time with you by call or WhatsApp.
points: Time confirmed by call or WhatsApp first
Ends with one recommended next step
sections.title: How the call runs

sections.body: We use the call to separate assumptions from real requirements. That means understanding the users, workflows, integrations, content, performance expectations, and operational constraints before recommending a build path.
sections.title: What we clarify on the call

sections.body: This call is useful when the project is serious enough that a generic quote would be misleading. It is especially valuable for multilingual websites, custom Next.js builds, ecommerce systems, dashboards, portals, and rebuild decisions.
points: Companies planning a rebuild of an existing site
Businesses that need more than one language, right-to-left included
Operators who need ownership of the code

sections.body: The outcome should be practical. You should leave with a clearer technical direction, a sense of whether Altruvex is the right partner, and a next step that matches the actual complexity of the work.
